title: The Hunter's Horn
wikitext: {{ Quest infobox | id = 36 | name = The Hunter's Horn | given by = [[Chantalle the Troubadour]] | given at = [[Lakeside County]] | region = Ascalon (pre-Searing) | campaign = Prophecies | type = Secondary | nationality = Tyrian | experience reward = 500 | completion reward = 50g ({{reforgedmode}} only), [[Longbow]] | map = [[File:The Hunter's Horn map.jpg|250px]] | map1text = The way to the [[Healing Spring (object)|Healing Spring]] and [[Aidan]]. }} Take the [[Hunter's Horn|hunter's horn]] from [[Chantalle the Troubadour]] to [[Regent Valley (pre-Searing)|Regent Valley]] to purify it. Then take it to [[Aidan]] in [[Wizard's Folly]]. == Quest information == === Requirements === {{ Standard prerequisites | campaign = pre | test = n }} === Objectives === * Purify the hunter's horn in the [[Healing Spring (object)|healing spring]] in Regent Valley. * Go to the fishing village south of the tower in Wizard's Folly and deliver the [[Purified Hunter's Horn|purified horn]] to Aidan. === Reward === * 500 [[Experience]] * 50 [[Gold]] ({{reforgedmode}} only) * [[Longbow (The Hunter's Horn)|Longbow of Fortitude (Half Moon skin)]] ** [[Piercing Dmg]]: 7-10 ** [[Health]] +10[[#salvageable|*]] ** Damage +15% (while Health is above 50%) ** Two-handed [[Flatbow]] * Can be [[salvage]]d == Walkthrough == After receiving the quest from Chantalle head southeast towards Regent Valley. Once you travel through the portal into Regent Valley start heading south towards the healing spring. This quest has a lot of running across long distances, so make sure your character will survive the journey. At the Healing Spring there are [[River Skale]], [[Black Bear]]s, [[Wolf|Wolves]], and all around are [[Grawl]], so when doing the quest make sure you take your time and kill everybody on the way. Once the area is safe, interact with the Healing Spring with the Hunter's Horn in your inventory. The item icon will brighten, signaling it has become purified. Follow your updated quest marker west to the entrance to Wizard's Folly. There, travel west along the river until you come to a fishing village, then go south and loop east, where you will find Aidan. Talk to him and get your reward. ==Interactive objects== * [[Healing Spring (object)]] == Dialogue == === Initial dialogue === ; Chantalle the Troubadour : ''"A while ago, I was given an old Minotaur horn by a Canthan trader. Out of it, I have fashioned a '''hunter's horn''', which I would like to give to '''Aidan'''. I have used all my art to fashion this horn, but the final step is beyond my talents. To fully reach its potential, this horn must be bathed in the water of a '''healing spring'''.'' : ''"Such a spring is rumored to be located in the south part of '''Regent Valley'''. Aidan, last I heard, was visiting the fishing village south of the tower in Wizard's Folly."'' {{ Offer dialog | accept = Sounds like fun. | decline = This is too much trouble for a horn. | ask = The first step is to find the '''healing spring''' in Regent Valley and purify the horn. Thus consecrated, I have hope this horn will prove worthy of Aidan. }} === Intermediate dialogue === ; Chantalle the Troubadour : ''"Now that you have purified the horn, all that remains is for you to deliver is to Aidan. Last I heard, he was visiting the fishing village south of the tower in Wizard's Folly."'' === Reward dialogue === ; Aidan : ''"What a beautiful horn. You needn't say who made it; I can see Chantalle's workmanship in every graven detail. I can also see that this horn has been purified in some way. Can it be that it was cleansed in a healing spring? Truly, this is the finest hunter's horn I have ever seen. I am deeply grateful for what you have done."'' == Notes == * The spot you purify the horn is close to the area where you are asked to [[charm]] an animal during the quest [[The Ranger's Companion]] from [[Master Ranger Nente]]. * If your character is either a primary or secondary [[Ranger]], you might consider going on to [[Ivor Trueshot]] and completing his quest before purifying the horn. You can then go to Aidan with the purified horn, and complete his Ranger quest as well while you are there. {{Pre-Searing Quest nav}}
